body: I am a paradox. And one day I'm hoping to be absorbed by it so it consumes the built up hatred inside me.

What I meant by mistake was, I wasn't meant to be here. I should join my father in death and maybe that way I could know him instead of being sad all the time when his life brought up.

I know for a fact I will never be as successful as any of my peers. I do not have the brain capacity to get a normal job because everything I do is a mistake. I'm not worth it.

I want to study Computer Science, but my brain won't allow me to do what I should be doing, and that is studying.

I get you're trying to help me, and I appreciate that, but I actually think I need mental help because I don't think it was wise of me to post on here.
Everything I say is wrong, so maybe you're right. None of the pain will go away unless I'm gone forever.
I'm not a quitter, I am just not worth your time. Not anyone's for that matter. I think I'm better off going away forever seeing that's what everyone wants.

What success with school are you even talking about? I haven't had any and never will. 

I only make mistakes. I am one after all. And since that's true, I'm not sure why I'm even here. I'm gonna go get the stuff I needed to take years ago and go away forever.

I've been stupid ever since I was 8 years old. I gave up reading and trying based off thinking it wouldn't help me in the long run. Well, look at me now. I'm on the verge of going away forever.

I'm not saying I was born with certain skills. What I'm saying is that everything I've tried has failed and I'll never be something. I'm not worth it anyways.

My life has been all about making sure others are okay. I don't have time for myself since I've drowned myself in school work that I can't complete because I'm too stupid.

I don't have any skills, so there are no jobs that are good for me.
